title: NoDebugCheat
description: NoDebugCheat blocks F3 and F3 keybind debug access for players without permission.
body:
NoDebugCheat blocks F3 and F3 keybind debug access for players without permission. Only opped or authorized users can use debug tools.

Regular players can still see coordinates by holding a compass, preventing F3 from being used as a cheat for location info, hitboxes, chunk borders, and other hidden data.
